rows.ARS:
Medium pink Floribunda.
Registration name: Delhi Princess
rows.Origin:
Bred by Dr. B.P. Pal (India, before 1963).
Introduced in India by Indian Agricultural Research Institute IARI in 1963 as 'Delhi Princess'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Mild fragrance. Large, semi-double (9-16 petals), in small clusters, open bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Ovoid buds.
